summary: Rows 5 and 6 have their whole CONTENT transposed - title AND date together. ja-WP gives 第伍話 はじまりの大隊 (2月3日) and 第陸話 狂気の幕開け (2月10日); en-WP's episode list gives ep 5 'My First Battalion' = 2017-02-03 and ep 6 'Beginning of Madness' = 2017-02-10; AniList's airing schedule agrees. Our ep 5 stores 'Beginning of Madness' + 2017-02-10 and our ep 6 stores 'My First Battalion' + 2017-02-03. Both dates are therefore wrong for their episode numbers, and the fix must swap the TITLES in the same operation or the rows will end up self-inconsistent. Eps 4, 7, 8 are correct and there is no numbering shift (the 2017-02-17 recap 6.5 is correctly absent from our rows).

repairs.why: Episode 5 is 'My First Battalion' (はじまりの大隊), aired 2017-02-03 (Fri 22:00, AT-X). ja-WP 各話リスト 第伍話 = 2月3日; en-WP episode list ep 5 = February 3, 2017; AniList airing schedule ep 5 = 2017-02-03. NOTE: our row 5 currently also holds ep 6's TITLE - swap the titles of rows 5 and 6 together with these dates.
Episode 6 is 'Beginning of Madness' (狂気の幕開け), aired 2017-02-10. ja-WP 第陸話 = 2月10日; en-WP ep 6 = February 10, 2017; AniList = 2017-02-10. Same transposition as ep 5 - swap the titles with the dates.

structure.notes: 12 rows; the 2017-02-17 recap (en-WP ep '6.5', 戦況報告) is not one of our rows, so ep 7 = 2017-02-24 is correct and there is no off-by-one.
